newsitem.title: CANADA: Champion to take C$2.5 mln Q4 writedown.
newsitem.headline: Champion to take C$2.5 mln Q4 writedown.

text.p: Champion Road Machinery Ltd said it will take a C$2.5 million restructuring charge against its fourth quarter earnings.

The maker of graders and asphalt pavers said the caharge will have a negative impact on earnings of C$0.22 a share and is related to restructuring of its Cambridge Snow and Ice Control and Pro-Pav businesses.

Champion said the money will be used to write down inventory of discontinued products and for staff reductions totalling 75 people. It said it expected full-year net profits per share to be in the C$0.10 to C$0.20 range.
